component: default-off live-row compaction for ordinary padded Qwen3.8 dense prefill MLPs
origin: Original mlx2 implementation. No external implementation source was copied. It applies the live-row packing concept already evaluated by mlx2 to the existing ordinary padded prefill route.
modifications: Publish exact per-chunk live row lengths from PromptProcessingBatch without changing its rectangular scheduler tensor or cache ownership.
Let the Qwen3.8 adapter install a model-owned context that gathers only live rows before each existing dense MLP and scatters results into a zero-padded rectangular residual shape.
Reuse the existing ordinary or TensorFold MLP implementation on the compacted rows; attention, GDN recurrence, cache operations, decode and mixed forward are unchanged.
Keep the policy default-off and bounded by minimum padding-row and padding-fraction thresholds, with mechanism counters and explicit status.
Add the numerical law and policy to the APCv2 prefill execution identity while excluding mutable counters.
Add a source-bound, one-load actual-HTTP A/B harness that switches the adapter-installed handle only at idle research-arm boundaries and requires exact responses plus nonzero mechanism counters.
Preserve adapter-owned target varlen policy parsing when the separately pinned external DFlash2 drafter route is selected, and add source-bound k4/k7 composed campaign arms.
